question: In D&D 5e, what are the effects of the Petrified condition?
expected_answer: A petrified creature is transformed into a solid inanimate substance (usually stone), along with any nonmagical objects it is wearing and carrying. Its weight increases by a factor of fifteen, and it ceases aging. It is Incapacitated, its Speed is 0 and can't increase. Attack rolls against it have Advantage. It automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws. It has Resistance to all damage and Immunity to the Poisoned condition.
